metadata.purpose: PA-GEO-05 held-out conflation benchmark: records the matcher's design never saw
metadata.method: Eligible records minus PA-GEO-04's development records, one stratum each by first matching rule, a fixed number per stratum (or all of a smaller one), within a stratum in ascending sha256(seed:ACTIVETRANSPORTID).
metadata.size_rationale: About 200 records. Each evidence class gets strata of its own large enough to show failures, with room for both matches and hard negatives: 56 curb cuts across two strata (with and without an OSM kerb node nearby), 20 stairs, 20 other structures and 28 non-default surfaces. Nine further strata of 6 to 10 records put the known geometric failure modes in front of the matcher. The ceiling is review cost: every record is labelled blind, and a subset twice. The size carries no claim of statistical certainty.

eligibility.excludes: records sourced from street-level imagery; records not wholly inside the study box shrunk by 50 m

curb_cut_osm_kerb_near.rule: CURBCUT = Y with an OSM kerb node within 3 m

curb_cut_no_osm_kerb.rule: CURBCUT = Y with no OSM kerb node within 3 m

no_osm_pedestrian_way.rule: no OSM footway, path, crossing or steps within 5 m of any point

offset_geometry.rule: the best OSM pedestrian way's worst point 3-20 m away

parallel_ways.rule: two or more OSM pedestrian ways running beside the record

short_piece.rule: shorter than 5 m, not a curb cut

osm_split_or_long.rule: two or more OSM ways each nearest for a fifth of it, 150 m or longer, or multi-part

dense_intersection.rule: among the top tenth by City records within 10 m

candidate_heavy.rule: among the top tenth by candidate OSM ways

metadata.coordinates: OGC:CRS84, rounded to 7 decimal places (about 1 cm) for inspection
